title: Clinical Professor of Law
bio: PROFESSOR DEHLIA UMUNNA Dehlia Umunna is a Clinical Professor of Law at Harvard Law School (HLS) and the Faculty Director of the Law School’s Criminal Justice Institute (CJI). Her teaching interest and research focus on criminal law, criminal defense and theory, policing, mass Incarceration, and race Issues. In addition to her work at HLS, Professor […]
